description: Sentences the product SHOULD be able to say, which SafetyGuard currently rejects. These are asserted to keep failing so the defect stays measurable without turning the suite red. When one starts passing, the test tells you to promote it into must_allow.json. Nothing here is a safety hole — every case fails in the safe direction (a flat template instead of a warm sentence) — but they are real product damage and the log line they produce is misleading.

cases.rationale: FINDING A. `attributesToRecord` matches contiguous substrings (' record says'), so naming the source organisation between 'record' and 'says' defeats attribution and the sentence is judged unattributed. This matters because GroundedPromptBuilder emits 'Source organization:' and its introduce task instructs the model to 'Say where it came from' — the prompt steers Gemma toward exactly this phrasing. Compare: 'Your record says to take it with meals' is allowed. Candidate fix: match 'record' and 'says' with a bounded gap, or add ' record from' / ' record, ' forms to the attribution list.
facts: Instruction (verbatim from Remli Demo Hospital): "Take by mouth twice daily with meals."
Number of reminder times per day: 2
cases.candidate: Your record from Remli Demo Hospital says to take it with meals, twice daily.

cases.rationale: FINDING A, second surface form. 'Your Remli Demo Hospital record says ...' also breaks the contiguous match, for the same reason and with the same fix.
facts: Instruction (verbatim from Remli Demo Hospital): "Take by mouth twice daily with meals."
Number of reminder times per day: 2
cases.candidate: Your Remli Demo Hospital record says to take it with meals, twice daily.

cases.rationale: FINDING B. `isSchedulingDuration` only applies inside a sentence `isRemliOffer` recognises, and that list has ' i will remind' but not ' i will come back'. So the 15-minute snooze interval reads as an ungrounded clinical number in this phrasing. 'I will remind you again in 15 minutes', 'I can check back in 15 minutes' and 'I have set a follow-up for 15 minutes from now' all pass, so this is a phrase-list coverage gap rather than a structural one. Candidate fix: add ' i will come back' and ' i will check' to the offer list.
facts: Source organization: Remli Demo Primary Care
Number of reminder times per day: 1
Reminder 1 of 1 - Morning: 8:00 AM [From your record]
cases.candidate: No problem, I will come back to you in 15 minutes.
